paite: Huchi in Israel tengteng khangthu a sim in a-om ua; huan, ngai in, Israel leh Judah Kumpipate Laibu ah gelh in a-om uhi: atatlekna ziak un Babulon lam ah sal a pimang in a-om uh.
heading: Saltanna A Kipan Hong Kik Nawnte

paite: Amau tante akhopite ua teng masapente bel, Israel, siampute, Levi mite leh Nethinim mite ahi uhi.
Jerusalem ah Judah tate, Benjamin tate, Ephraim leh Manasseh tate ateng uhi.
Ammihud tapa Uthai, Omri tapa, Imri tapa, Bani tapa, Perez tapate ah Judah tapa.
Shilon mite; Asaiah piang masapen leh atapate.
Zerah tapate ah; Jeuel, a-unaute, zaguk-le-sawmkua ahi uh.
Benjamin tapate ah; Meshullam tapa Sallu, Hodaviah tapa, Hassenuah tapa;
Huan Jeroham tapa Ibneiah, Uzzi tapa Elah, Mikri tapa, Shephatiah tapa Meshallum, Reuel tapa, Ibnijah tapa.
A-unaute uh, akhangte uh dungzui in, zakua sawmnga-le-guk ahi uh. Hiai mite tengteng apipute uh inkote dungzui a alupente ahi uhi.
Huan siampute ah: Jedaiah, Jehoiarib; Jachin;
heading: Jerusalem A Teng Siampute

paite: Hilkiah tapa Azariah, Meshullam tapa, Ahitub tapa, Pathian inn a vaihawmpa;
Jeroham tapa Adaiah, Pashur tapa, Malkijah tapa, Maasai Adiel tapa, Jahzerah tapa, Meshullam tapa, Meshillemit tapa, Immer tapa;
A-unaute uh, apipute uh lupente, sangkhat zasagih-le-sawmguk; Pathian inn a nasepna thilhihna ding a mihithei mahmahte ahi uh.
Huan Levi mite ah: Hashub tapa Shemaiah, Azrikam tapa, Hashabiah tapa, Merari tapate ah;
heading: Jerusalem A Teng Levite

paite: Bakbakkar, Heresh, Galal, Mika tapa Mattaniah, Zikri tapa, Asaph tapa;
Shemaiah tapa Obadiah, Galal tapa, Jeduthun tapa, Asa tapa Berekiah, Elkanah tapa, Netophah mite khuate a tengte.
Huan kongkhak ngak mite; Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, Ahiman, a-unaute uh, Shallum bel amakaipen ahi.
heading: Tempul Vengtu Jerusalem A Tengte

paite: Kumpipa kongpi suahlam pang ngak sek: Levi tate puanin a dia kongkhak ngak mite ahi uhi.

Kore tapa Shallum, Ebiasaph tapa, Korah tapa, a-unaute, apa inkote a, Korah mite, nasepna thilhihna a heutu ahi ua, biakbuk kongpite ngak mite: apipute uh TOUPA puanin tung a heutu, biakbuk lutna ngak mite ahi uhi.
Eleazar tapa Phinehas hun paisa ah amaute tung a vaihawmpa ahi a, akiang ah TOUPA a-om hi.
Meshelemiah tapa Zekariah kihoupihna biakbuk kongkhak ngakpa ahi.
Hiaite tengteng kongpite kongkhak ngak mite hi ding a telte zanih sawm-le-nih ahi uh. Hiaite akhuate ua khangthu a simte ahi ua, asep ding uh bawlsa a David leh zawlnei Samuel in ahihkipsate ahi uhi.
Huchi in amau leh atapate un TOUPA' inn kongpite, adandan in, biakbuk inn nangawn in akem uhi.
Apang lite ah, suahlam, tumlam, mallam, simlam ah kongkhak ngak mite a-om uhi.
A-unaute uh, akallak lak in ni sagih nite teng in amau kiang a om ding in ahong pai zel ding uh ahi:
Kongkhak ngakpipen lite lah, Levi mite, sep ding sehsa a om ahi ua, Pathian insung a dantante leh sumkoihnate tung ah heutu ahi uhi.
Huai lai a thupiak amau tung a a-om ziak in, Pathian inn kimvel ah agiak ua, zingsang teng in huai hon ding amau nasep ahi.
Huan alak ua kuate hiam in nasepna tui-um belsuante akem ua; alaklut uleh alakkhiak teng un aphazah asim gige uhi.
heading: Levi Dangte

paite: Alak ua khenkhatte vante, mun siangthoupen tui-um belsuan tangbuang nelte, uainte, sathaute begaw leh gimnamtuite kem ding a seh ahi uhi.
Siampute tapate lak a akhente gimnamtuite toh hel in abawl uh.
Mattithiah, Levi mite, Korah mi Shallum ta masapen lak a khat in belliangneite kan thilte tung a nasepna sehsa anei hi.
A-unaute uh lak a akhen, Sabbathte a bawl ding in, Kohath mite tapate'n tanghou akem uhi.
Hiaite lasa mite ahi ua, Levi mite inkote pipute inkuan a lupente, dantante sung ah ateng ua, sun leh zan in anasepna ua zat in a-om ua, nasepna dangte a kipan a-awl uhi.
Akhang pumpite uah, hiaite Levi mite pipute inkuan makaipente ahi uh, amakaipente: hiaite Jerusalem ah ateng uhi.
Huan Gibeon ah Gibeon pa ateng a, Jehiel, azi min Maakah:
heading: Kumpipa Saul Suangtute Leh Amah Suante / (1 Kro 8.29-38)

paite: Atapa masapen Abdon, Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab;
Gedor, Ahio, Zekariah, Mikloth.
Huan Mikloth in Shimeam asuang a, huchi in amau leng a-unaute uh toh Jerusalem ah, a-unaute uh zawn ah ateng uhi.
Ner in Kish asuang a; Kish in Saul asuang; Saul in Jonathan, Malki- shua, Abinadab leh Eshbaal asuang hi.
Jonathan tapa bel Merib-baal ahi; Merib-baal in Mikah asuang hi.
Huan Mikah tapate: Pithon, Melek, Tahrea leh Ahaz.
Ahaz in Jarah asuang; Jara in Alameth, Azmaveth leh Zimri asuang hi; Zimri in Moza asuang hi.
Moza in Binea asuang; Rephaiah atapa, Eleasah atapa, Azel atapa;
Azel in tapa guk anei a, amin uh hiaite ahi: Azrikam, Bokeru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah leh Hanan: hiaite Azel tapate ahi uh.
